correctness.rationale: The spectral 2×2 blocks are reconstructed directly from the explicit corona transition matrix. β≤2d forces all negative modes below the λ+(α) envelope; F is strictly convex with F′(0)=-1, F′(1)=c>0 and stated unique stationary solution. At the optimizer a*≤1/2, the remaining 1−2a mode is dominated. Automorphism averaging proves unrestricted optimality. Full transition-matrix eigencomputations and symbolic stationarity checks passed 1768 finite assertions; finite checks do not establish the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The natural question of how one attached private leaf per vertex changes optimal stochastic mixing is resolved for all vertex- and edge-transitive bases in a single spectral ratio. The exact β-independence collapses the apparent two-endpoint minimax, the core holding probability vanishes, and the leaf weight scales as √(α/d) even when the spectral gap scales as α/d. This supplies parameter choices for complete, bipartite, hypercube, cycle, Johnson and other transitive networks; it is a structural all-family design law rather than a one-parameter exercise.
